name: Whirlpool TL DD 5100 Inlet Valve Coil Resistance (J16)
purpose: Solenoid coils on J16 valve harness — common J16-1 (LINE_OUT) to valve pin.
failureModes: Open coil — no fill on that leg (F8E1 / LF)
Tens of ohms outside range — replace valve assembly
testingTips: W11416787 DD TEST #2 — Fabric Softener J16-1&6, Oxi J16-1&7, Hot J16-1&5, Cold J16-1&2
Live valve test via Service Diagnostics Component Activation

name: Whirlpool TL DD 5100 BPM Motor Winding Resistance (J3)
purpose: Direct-drive BPM stator at ACU J3 and motor connector — pairs 1-2, 1-3 and motor 2-4, 2-3.
failureModes: Open winding — F7E6 motor circuit open
Very low — shorted stator (F7E3 over current)
testingTips: W11416787 DD TEST #3b — measure at J3 then at drive motor connector
Impeller must turn freely and not be connected to basket

name: Whirlpool TL DD 5100 Drain Pump Resistance (J15)
purpose: Drain pump winding at J15-1 (Neutral) and J15-2 (Drain Pump).
failureModes: Good ohms but no run — ACU relay or obstruction
testingTips: W11416787 DD TEST #7 — verify at pump terminals after harness check
Component Activation drain pump toggle before bench ohms

name: Whirlpool TL DD 5100 Recirculation Pump Resistance (J15)
purpose: Recirculation pump winding at J15-1 (Neutral) and J15-3 (Recirc Pump).
failureModes: Good ohms but no run — ACU relay or obstruction
testingTips: W11416787 DD TEST #7 — not on all models
Verify recirc pump harness J15-3 (Blue) to pump pin 1

name: Whirlpool TL DD 5100 Lid Lock Solenoid Resistance (J6)
purpose: Lid lock solenoid at J6-2 and J6-3.
failureModes: Switch state mismatch — replace lid lock mechanism
testingTips: W11416787 DD TEST #8 — lock switch J6-1↔2; lid switch J6-2↔1
Run Lid Lock test in Service Load Control before bench ohms

name: Whirlpool TL DD 5100 Inlet Thermistor Resistance (J16)
purpose: Inlet water thermistor at J16-4 (NTC) and J16-8 (AGND). ~50 kΩ at 77°F (25°C) per OEM table.
failureModes: Open or short — F3E3 inlet water temperature fault
Out of range — replace valve assembly (thermistor integral)
testingTips: Compare to OEM R/T table in TEST #5
Use Sensor Feedback Inlet Thermistor test before bench ohms

name: Whirlpool TL DD 5100 ACU +12.7 VDC Supply (J14)
purpose: +12.7 VDC at J14-1 vs J14-4 (Circuit Gnd) with J14 disconnected from HMI load check.
failureModes: DC present but LED not flashing — ACU micro failure
testingTips: W11416787 DD TEST #1 — remove J14 to isolate HMI load on DC supply
Diagnostic LED flashing = processor operating (per manual)

name: Whirlpool TL DD 5100 Load & Go Bulk Pump Resistance (J17)
purpose: Bulk dispense pump at J17-2 and J17-3.
failureModes: Good ohms but no run — ACU or harness
testingTips: W11416787 DD TEST #9 — verify extension harness at pump through top
Component Activation Detergent Pump before bench ohms
